name: biz-system-architecture
title: Business System Architecture
description: Layered system architecture that folds into an isometric plane, builds layer by layer and then lights the cross-layer flow.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: AI may rewrite every content variable within its limits, choose the skin and camera, and bind measured cue times. Colours and fonts always come from the active --ipw-* theme.

variables.label: Layers (label@icon::node@icon, node | ...)
variables.default: 接入层@globe::Web@globe,iOS / Android@phone,智能硬件@mic,Open API@api|服务层@server::API 网关@shield,Agent 编排@agent,会话与记忆@chat|模型层@brain::教育大模型@spark,语音 ASR/TTS@sound,Embedding@grid|数据层@db::向量库@db,题库与课程@book,学情数仓@chart

variables.label: Emphasised layers or nodes (comma separated)
variables.default: 模型层,Agent 编排,教育大模型,向量库

variables.label: Visual skin
variables.description: Visual language only; colors and fonts always come from the active --ipw-* theme.

variables.label: Camera
variables.description: Camera move with enter, hold drift and exit phases on the composition timeline.

variables.label: Semantic cue times
variables.description: JSON event IDs to measured scene-relative seconds. Empty uses content-paced defaults; this is not word alignment.

usage.intent: 把系统按层搭起来，再点亮跨层调用路径，让观众理解“请求怎样穿过系统”。
useWhen: Explain a layered software or platform architecture with 2–5 layers and the calls between them.
avoidWhen: Do not mix deployment topology or message timing into the layers; use a sequence for ordered calls.

inputRules.layers: 2–5 entries top to bottom separated by "|": label@icon::node@icon, node. 1–5 nodes per layer, ≤ 12 characters each.
inputRules.links: Comma-separated from>to pairs using exact node labels; omit to show layers only.
inputRules.emphasis: Comma-separated layer or node labels that form the featured path.
inputRules.skin: keynote for calm launches, cinematic for dark stages, editorial for print-like explainers, dot for hardware/AI moods; colours still follow --ipw-*.
inputRules.camera: flat by default; tilt, iso, unfold or dolly only when depth helps the story. The camera enters, drifts while held and exits with the scene.

readingOrder: See the layers form one by one

cueBindings.step-1: When narration reaches layer 1, build it.
cueBindings.step-2: When narration reaches layer 2, build it.
cueBindings.step-3: When narration reaches layer 3, build it.
cueBindings.step-4: When narration reaches layer 4, build it.
cueBindings.step-5: When narration reaches layer 5, build it.
cueBindings.resolve: When narration explains how a request travels, draw the links and show the whole architecture.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or choose a sparser business diagram; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once in order; keep authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary instead of stretching speech.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another business diagram or registry recipe whose structure matches the content, split the content, or report the gap.

values.layers: 接入层@globe::Web,App|服务层@server::Agent 编排|模型层@brain::教育大模型
values.links: Web>Agent 编排,Agent 编排>教育大模型

example.narration: 请求从网页和 App 进来，经过 Agent 编排，最后交给教育大模型。

acceptance: Every active layer event builds its layer; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
Links only connect labels that exist in the layers.
The final isometric state keeps every label readable inside the stage.
Test Chinese content with 2 and 5 layers, and reject a sixth layer.
